title: IM60041: Technology Management
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Technology management – Scope, components, and overview. Technology and
environment, Technology and society, Technology Impact analysis, environmental,
social, legal, political aspects, methods or techniques for analysis – steps
involved. Technology policy strategy: Science and technology Policy of India,
implications to industry.
Technology forecasting – need, methodology and methods – trend Analysis,
Analogy, Delphi, Soft System Methodology, Mathematical Models, Simulation, and
System Dynamics.
Technology Choice and Evaluation – Methods of analyzing alternate technologies,
Techno-economic feasibility studies, Need for multi-criteria considerations
such as, social, environmental, and political, Analytic hierarchy method,
Fuzzy multi-criteria decision making, and other methods.
Technology Transfer and Acquisition – Import regulations, Implications of
“Uruguay Round”, and WTO, Bargaining process, Transfer option, MOU.
Technology Adoption and Productivity – Adopting technology-human interactions,
Organizational redesign and re-engineering, Technology productivity.
Technology Absorption and Innovation – present status in India, Need for new
outlook, Absorption strategies for acquired technology, Creating new/improved
technologies, Innovations. Technology Measurement. Technology Audit.

Text
•From Knowledge Management To Strategic Competence: Measuring Technological,
Market and Organisational Innovation (Second Edition), edited by Joe Tidd
(SPRU, University of Sussex, UK)
•Market-Oriented Technology Management by Fred Phillips, Springer
•Technology Management – Lecture Notes, Ed. K. Vizayakumar, IIT, Kharagpur.
Reference Books
•Management of Technology (Hardcover) by Tarek Khalil, Maximilian von Zedtwitz,
Georges Haour, Louis A. Lefebvre, Pergamon.
•Management of Technology: Key Success Factors for Innovation and Sustainable
Development by Laure Morel- Guimaraes, Tarek Khalil, Yasser A Hosni , Elsevier
Science.
•Technology Management:Text and International Cases by Norma Harrison, Danny
Samson , McGraw-Hill/Irwin; 1 edition, 2001, ISBN: 0072383550
